{{Quote|What took you? I thought you were right behind me.''"<br>''"I picked up a sack of maraffa twigs.|[[Kels Turkhorn]] and Dawson|<ref name="FP" />}}
'''Maraffa twigs''' were the twigs of the [[Maraffa]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. The twigs contained an [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Sugar/Legends|sugary]] [[Maraffa sap|sap]] with a pleasant odor, and were sold as [[Candy/Legends|candy]]. While on Kabal<ref name="FP" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="FPWhen">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and demolition expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] partook of several maraffa twigs after an attempt to secure a [[Quay novelty toy]] from a local [[Unidentified Squib trader (Kabal)|Squib trader]] fell through. The Tynnan later used maraffa sap to adapt the Quay into a makeshift [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]] during an effort to rescue his superior [[Cecil Noone]] from [[Krish (species)|Krish]] business magnate and [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maraffa twigs first appeared in the short story "[[Fair Prey]]", which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in [[Star Wars Gamer 1|''Star Wars Gamer'' 1]] in [[November]] [[2000]].<ref name="FP" />
